% ============================================================================
% components/icons.tex — Official Solar Bold Duotone Icons (Pure TikZ SVG Paths)
% ============================================================================
% Rendered from official 24x24 Solar Bold Duotone SVG geometry via TikZ `svg.path`
% (zero PUA font characters in the PDF text stream — 100% ATS-safe!).
% - Section icons: 1.25x of 9.5pt Sora heading (~11.88pt box).
% - Contact icons: 1.18x of 8.5pt Inter metadata (~10.03pt box).

\usetikzlibrary{svg.path}

\def\SectionIconScale{\fpeval{round(9.5 * 1.25 / 24, 4)}}
\def\ContactIconScale{\fpeval{round(8.5 * 1.18 / 24, 4)}}

\ExplSyntaxOn
\NewDocumentCommand{\DeclareVecIcon}{m m}
  {
    \cs_new:cpn { vecicon@#1 } { #2 }
  }

\NewDocumentCommand{\CVIcon}{m}
  {
    \IfCVIconsT
      {
        \cs_if_exist:cT { vecicon@#1 }
          { \use:c { vecicon@#1 }\hspace{\SpaceSix} }
      }
  }

\NewDocumentCommand{\DeclareContactIcon}{m m}
  {
    \cs_new:cpn { contacticon@#1 } { #2 }
  }

\NewDocumentCommand{\CVContactIcon}{m}
  {
    \IfCVIconsT
      {
        \cs_if_exist:cT { contacticon@#1 }
          { \use:c { contacticon@#1 }\hspace{3.5pt} }
      }
  }
\ExplSyntaxOff
